description: District 67 Update As 2025 legislative session has ended, I am filled with gratitude for the opportunity to serve you. This work has never been about politics, it has always been rooted in people. It is grounded in the families working hard to build better lives, the students striving toward their dreams, the veterans who have given so much, and the seniors who deserve the dignity of a secure and stable future.
